newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 700,800 MT were 38 percent greater than the week earlier and one-tenth higher than the 4-week average. Major increases for Japan (186,700 MT), Taiwan (99,000 MT), Egypt (96,500 MT, includes 1,800 in new sales, 95,400 in destination changes, 700 in cancellations), South Korea (60,200 MT, includes 8,100 in new sales, 52,500 in destination changes, 400 in cancellations), Colombia (59,900 MT), Algeria (53,900 MT), Saudi Arabia (51,800 MT), and Jordan (50,000 MT) were partially offset by decreases reported for unknown destinations (96,000 MT).

Exports of 1,574,700 MT--a marketing-year high--were up 23 percent from the prior week and 21 from the 4-week average. Japan (390,100 MT), South Korea (381,900 MT), Egypt (146,500 MT), Mexico (109,000 MT), Colombia (78,100 MT), Taiwan (56,500 MT), Saudi Arabia (51,800 MT), and Jordan (50,000 MT) were the primary recipients
